definitions: To carry and turn over (letters, goods, etc.) to a recipient or to an intended destination.
To present or utter (a speech, lecture, etc.).
To save or set free; to rescue.
To produce the promised, desired, or expected results.
examples: She delivered a healthy baby boy.
They prayed to be delivered from evil.
The team delivered on their promise to win.
pastTenses: delivered (past simple), delivered (present perfect), delivered (past perfect)
